model.name: Task-status symbols: ONE shared source (server+client), all statuses incl the band, enforced by a WIRED-strict RED-on-live lint
model.description: The task-status SYMBOL rendering has ONE source, both server and client, covering ALL statuses including the band — enforced by a lint that is WIRED strict and PROVEN RED on the live defect. DEFECT (verified first-hand): Tron's board renders raw gray text 'qa-review-with-open-cr' instead of the band glyph, because the SERVER STATUS_GLYPHS (task-status.ts:117, 🔁 = QA-Review-with-open-CR) HAS it but the CLIENT BADGE_MAP (rb-object-item.ts:233) does NOT — two symbol tables maintained SEPARATELY; the band status falls through BADGE_MAP[status]||…||null -> raw text. CLASS FIX (what this req mints): a shared dep-free task-status source both import + its enforcing lint. NOTE: the user-visible band-glyph fix itself lands under EXISTING T40.1 units (no new req — repairing a broken render of a feature T40.1 owns); THIS req is the CLASS work.

model.metaFinding: ★ check-status-symbol.ts PASSES GREEN (exit 0) while the defect it is NAMED FOR stands — it does not merely FAIL TO CATCH, it CERTIFIES. WORSE than no guard, because the board reads it as coverage. Root: it EXISTS but is UNWIRED (0 mentions in package.json), its 2nd-vocabulary detector is REPORT-ONLY (never --strict), and it covers the SERVER vocabulary while the CLIENT BADGE_MAP + the band go unchecked. ★ A GUARD HAS THREE FAILURE MODES — EXISTS / WIRED / COVERS-THE-CLASS — all three must be closed or the green is HOLLOW; plus RED-ON-THE-LIVE-DEFECT (a lint that cannot red on its own motivating defect is the wrong lint). acceptanceCriteria.text: EXISTS: a SHARED dep-free task-status source (expert proposal task-status-glyphs.ts) that BOTH server and client import — client task rows derive their glyph/badge from it; the generic NON-task badges (pass/fail/impl-done…) stay in BADGE_MAP. gateRef.assertion: task-status glyphs resolve from the ONE shared source on both server+client; a 2nd task-status symbol table => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING: seed a 2nd task-status symbol table (or a client-local band glyph) diverging from the shared source => RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: WIRED: the lint is in ci:gates:raw as STRICT, NEVER report-only. Report-only is EXACTLY how check-status-symbol.ts hid: it EXISTS, was NEVER wired (0 mentions in package.json, measured), and its 2nd-vocabulary detector was REPORT-ONLY so it missed BADGE_MAP entirely. A lint not in the strict gate does not exist for CI. (Target: 1 strict gate entry; report-only=0.)

gateRef.assertion: the lint runs in ci:gates:raw with --strict (non-zero exit on violation); a report-only/absent wiring => the gate itself fails

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING: set the lint report-only (or remove from ci:gates) while the defect stands -> the wiring-check => RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: COVERS THE CLASS: the lint covers the CLIENT badge render AND ALL statuses INCLUDING the band (QA-Review-with-open-CR), not just the server table. The check-status-symbol miss was covering the server vocabulary while the CLIENT BADGE_MAP + the band status went unchecked. Every TaskStatusEnum value (Planned/In Progress/QA-Review-with-open-CR/QA Review/Done) MUST have a render on both surfaces via the shared source.

gateRef.assertion: every TaskStatusEnum incl the band renders (no raw-text fallthrough) on the CLIENT surface via the shared source; a status with no client glyph => RED
